name: Assault on the Kolkar
summary: In Magram Village, Warug wants you to prove you can kill Kolkar as the Magram do. After Brutal Politics, you head north to face Kolkar centaurs, scouts and maulers.

sections.title: We Laugh and We Kill
sections.body: Warug mocks the Kolkar and their belief that they are strong. The Magram laugh as they kill them, and Warug wants you to prove you can do the same. Head north and slay twelve Kolkar centaurs, twelve scouts and six maulers.

sections.title: Warug's Approval
sections.body: When you return, Warug says the Kolkar fear you now. He hopes you laughed as you killed them, so the enemy could see its own weakness.

faq.q: Who sends you to attack the Kolkar?
aliases: who gives assault on the kolkar
quest giver assault on the kolkar
where to get assault on the kolkar
faq.answer: Warug of the Magram sends you from Magram Village in Desolace.
Warug tells you to head north to find the Kolkar.

faq.q: Why does Warug want the Kolkar killed?
faq.answer: Warug mocks the Kolkar for thinking themselves strong. He wants you to show you can kill them as the Magram do.
